nodes.label: Always-rendered FAQ answer with CSS-only mobile collapse
nodes.rationale: The answer is always in the DOM and the desktop/mobile split is pure CSS at the 996px Docusaurus breakpoint, so there is no hydration flash and search engines plus the docs AI bot can read the answer regardless of collapsed state. The heading id resolves deep links on both layouts; toggling uses history.replaceState so an opened answer is shareable without history spam or an abrupt scroll.
